value.rationale: The trace-zero subspace is canonical and two-dimensional generating planes are minimal-dimensional generators of a noncommutative matrix algebra. The result gives a complete conjugacy classification, exact orbit and stabilizer sizes, and the characteristic-two invariant change, refining a total count into structural types.
